title: Car Plunging Into Deep Water (Floats Only 30–60 Seconds!): Unbuckle -> Open/Break SIDE Window Immediately -> Children Out -> Swim!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: Top road shows three cars all facing away in same direction; submerged blue sedan is in lake water right of road, not in a traffic lane facing anyone.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Bottom insets show driver interior with left-shoulder to right-hip belt and wheel directly in front of driver; no wheel mounted on right side of cabin.

single_bulb_signal.note: Vertical signal on far right foreground shows only bottom green lens lit, upper red/yellow dark.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Top road: double-yellow centerline on left of gray sedan's travel lane, white edge line/curb and guardrail on right; traffic proceeds on right.

zero_text.note: All signs, plates, and inset icons are blank shapes/pictograms; chevron arrow, diamond sign, plates show no letters or numbers.

scene_match.note: Top shows sedan floating nose-heavy sinking in lake beside road; bottom three panels show unbuckle, strike side-window corner with tool, lift child onto roof — exactly the described steps.

result.summary: Three-step water-escape graphic correctly shows nose-heavy float, immediate unbuckle, side-window break, and child-out, with all visual rules satisfied.

teaching_correct.note: Teaches correct order: unbuckle first, break/open SIDE window before water covers it, never wait for doors, children out onto roof; no wrong geometry.

result.what_i_see: Top widescreen shows a lakeside road at sunset with a blue sedan sinking nose-first in water right of the guardrail; bottom strip has three close-ups of a driver unbuckling, breaking a side window with a tool, and lifting a boy onto the submerged car roof.
